snippet.title: What Happens at SCAR | Unreal Jam 2020
snippet.description:
WARNING: Might trigger epileptic seizures.  



Set aboard on a spacecraft, you play as a soldier trying to make sense of a system failure amidst a virus outbreak, which doesn't necessarily seem as it looks to be like.


sed-team 2020


#unrealjam #epicgames #sed-team
